# CasADi dependency

This directory is the expected local installation path for CasADi 3.8.0 for
Windows 64-bit MATLAB. The binary distribution is intentionally not committed
to the GitHub code repository; it is a third-party dependency and contains
platform-specific binaries.

Install the official CasADi 3.8.0 Windows/MATLAB package into this directory,
preserving the `+casadi` folder and the `casadiMEX.mexw64` runtime. The main
repository requires MATLAB R2025a, CasADi 3.8.0 and the Deep Learning Toolbox.
